tools.name: discover_projs
tools.description: Scan a directory for .xcworkspace, .xcodeproj and Package.swift (skipping node_modules, Pods, .build, DerivedData). Local; no Mac needed.

tools.name: list_schemes
tools.description: List shared schemes of a project or workspace by reading xcshareddata (local). Unshared schemes are not visible; if none are listed, ds infers the scheme from the app target on the Mac.

tools.name: list_sims
tools.description: List simulator devices, iOS runtimes and Xcode versions available on the doublespeed fleet.

tools.name: check_project
tools.description: Lint-only check on a real Mac: resolves the project/workspace/package and schemes with xcodebuild -list, parses every Swift file with swiftc (syntax, file:line:col), lints plists. Does NOT compile. Works without DS_API_KEY (keyless trial: 10 per day per address, 25 MB snapshot). Use this to validate structure before asking the user for a key; use build_sim/test_sim for a real build.

workspaceRoot.description: Directory to upload as the project root (default: the directory containing the project/workspace, or the current directory). Only files under it are sent.

projectPath.description: Path to the .xcodeproj (omit for a workspace or a Swift package)

workspacePath.description: Path to the .xcworkspace (CocoaPods / React Native projects)

tools.name: build_sim
tools.description: Compile the project for the iOS Simulator on a Mac in the doublespeed fleet. Returns file:line:col errors. Use when there is no Xcode locally.

workspaceRoot.description: Directory to upload as the project root (default: the directory containing the project/workspace, or the current directory). Only files under it are sent.

projectPath.description: Path to the .xcodeproj (omit for a workspace or a Swift package)

workspacePath.description: Path to the .xcworkspace (CocoaPods / React Native projects)

scheme.description: Scheme to build; inferred when the project has exactly one app scheme

simulatorName.description: Simulator device name, e.g. 'iPhone 16 Pro' (default iPhone 16)

configuration.description: Debug or Release (default: what the scheme defines)

xcodeVersion.description: Required Xcode major or exact version, e.g. '16' or '16.4'

collectApp.description: Also upload the built .app as an artifact

tools.name: test_sim
tools.description: Build and run XCTest / Swift Testing on an iOS Simulator on the doublespeed fleet. Returns per-test results and compile errors.

scheme.description: Scheme to build; inferred when the project has exactly one app scheme

simulatorName.description: Simulator device name, e.g. 'iPhone 16 Pro' (default iPhone 16)

configuration.description: Debug or Release (default: what the scheme defines)

xcodeVersion.description: Required Xcode major or exact version, e.g. '16' or '16.4'

tools.name: build_run_sim
tools.description: Build, install and launch the app in an iOS Simulator on the fleet and return a browser URL where a human can see and use it (tap, type, swipe). The session stays open until stop_app_sim or the idle timeout. Billed per second while open.

workspaceRoot.description: Directory to upload as the project root (default: the directory containing the project/workspace, or the current directory). Only files under it are sent.

projectPath.description: Path to the .xcodeproj (omit for a workspace or a Swift package)

workspacePath.description: Path to the .xcworkspace (CocoaPods / React Native projects)

scheme.description: Scheme to build; inferred when the project has exactly one app scheme

simulatorName.description: Simulator device name, e.g. 'iPhone 16 Pro' (default iPhone 16)

configuration.description: Debug or Release (default: what the scheme defines)

xcodeVersion.description: Required Xcode major or exact version, e.g. '16' or '16.4'

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: End the session after this long with no viewer activity (60–7200, default 900)

tools.name: stop_app_sim
tools.description: End a live simulator session started by build_run_sim (frees the Mac; stops billing).

tools.name: archive_app
tools.description: Produce an unsigned .xcarchive for the device SDK on the fleet (Release). Signing and TestFlight upload are not available yet.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Fetch a previous job (status, error, diagnostics, tests) and optionally its log tail.

logLines.description: Return the last N log lines (default 0)

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check that this machine can reach the doublespeed fleet: key present, API reachable, fleet capabilities, ds CLI version.
